line_tangent: Only a retained exact quadratic affine chart with certified distinct endpoints may return its directed support delta. Its traversal derivative is a positive multiple of that direction.
circle_tangent: At a finite endpoint, a rational Bezier derivative is degree times the adjacent homogeneous cross-difference divided by endpoint_weight squared. The sign of radial cross that numerator determines the local orientation. A positive radius-squared and nonzero endpoint weight are required.
stationary_or_undecided: Zero or unresolved cross products decline the shortcut and retain the previous derivative path. No global circle traversal direction is assumed.
single_arc_recovery: A retained circle of degree greater than two now requires a strict injectivity certificate before start/end/orientation can represent the image as one arc. The existing exact quadratic-reduction fallback remains.
remaining_audit: The separate regularization retained_regular_circle fallback still describes arbitrary circle support as regular. Restrict that fallback to a proven regular quadratic chart or use the local derivative certificate before retaining production changes.
